name: council
description: Run Codex council reviews only on supplied inline text or explicit files; no memory, repo, git, Claude asset, local discovery, or raw child output.

interface.shortDescription: Run strictly bounded Codex reviewer-agent councils
interface.longDescription: Strict $council/review/debate. Inline text is complete unless the user gives @path, exact files, a diff, or direct read/search. No memory, prior sessions, repo/local-file discovery, git history, Claude assets, web, raw child output, or raw subagent notifications. all/broad >6 without approval outputs exact denial with no tools/commentary. Otherwise load SKILL first, then spawn every selected high-effort native reviewer with exact prompt templates and complete bounded material.
defaultPrompt: Use $council for bounded high-effort reviewer-agent reviews; inline text is full scope.
$council never truncates fixed rosters, skips mandatory headings, queues next-wave spawns before closes, sends malformed prompts, sends shorthand material, or leaks raw child payloads.
